figure.description: No cell diagram was included, so the labels cannot be matched to particular pointers. If the diagrams show a plant cell and an animal cell, use the label bank below.
figure.title: Cell diagrams

steps: For a plant cell, label: cell wall, cell membrane, cytoplasm, nucleus, large central vacuole, chloroplasts, mitochondria, endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi apparatus and ribosomes, where shown.
For an animal cell, label: cell membrane, cytoplasm, nucleus, mitochondria, endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi apparatus and ribosomes, where shown; do not label a cell wall or chloroplasts.
The original diagrams are needed to match these names to specific arrows or numbered pointers.
items.finalAnswer: Likely labels for the plant cell: cell wall, cell membrane, cytoplasm, nucleus, large central vacuole, chloroplasts, mitochondria, endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi apparatus and ribosomes. Likely labels for the animal cell: cell membrane, cytoplasm, nucleus, mitochondria, endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi apparatus and ribosomes. Exact pointer matching requires the diagrams.

figure.description: No flower diagram was included, so the labels cannot be matched to particular pointers.
figure.title: Flower

steps: Label the female reproductive parts: stigma, style, ovary and ovules.
Label the male reproductive parts: anther and filament.
Also label the petals, sepals, receptacle and flower stalk (pedicel) if these are shown.
The original diagram is needed to match the names to specific arrows or numbered pointers.
items.finalAnswer: The usual parts labelled on a flower diagram are stigma, style, ovary, ovules, anther, filament, petals, sepals, receptacle and pedicel. Exact pointer matching requires the diagram.
